title: Probes and Plugs — Feedback Compendium and Quick-Proposals (Jul 2025)
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, pragmatic digest of customer feedback collected during June–July 2025 field engagements (onboarding calls, SRE postmortems, and AE check-ins). Focus is on proposals we can reasonably ship as small probes (1–3 week) or plug-in features (quarterly) that materially reduce friction for high-value customers.

How to use this doc:
- Quick reference for PM/SE/Eng pairing when scoping small fixes.
- Source material for a 2-week pilot backlog.
- Contains raw customer vignettes + synthesis + proposed experiment designs.

Topline themes (synthesized):
1) Erratic tail latency on mixed workloads — customers report occasional 2–3x latency spikes during bursty chat traffic; visibility gaps in per-route tail stats.
2) Model fallbacks and semantic drift — teams want safer, lower-cost fallback policies that preserve semantic alignment (not just smallest model).
3) Token accounting surprises — embed+chat combos causing unexpected bill/usage spikes; customers ask for simulated-cost tooling.
4) Integration pain points — particularly with webhooks and SSO for Private deployments; transient 403s are a frequent blocker.
5) Output formatting & structured calls — customers want deterministic JSON schema enforcement for function/tool calling.

Representative raw crumbs (anonymized):
- "We saw 800ms median but then a bunch of 2.8s responses during peak — no obvious correlated error logs." — fintech beta
- "Fallback to the smaller model produced hallucinated policy text; can't do that for compliance workflows." — health enterprise
- "Our invoices jumped when we started embedding search in chat widgets; we'd love a sandboxed cost preview." — marketplace app
- "Signed webhooks sometimes fail during deploys and require manual re-registering in the console." — retail partner
- "Tool-calling returned keys in varied orders; our parser is brittle." — internal integrator

Priority candidate probes (1–3 week, low effort):
A) Tail-latency quicktrace: add a lightweight per-route 95/99 tracersampled log (no PII) with percentiles and last-10-requests view in Console.
   - Why: customers need rapid triage without asking SRE for traces.
   - Metrics: 95/99 latency visible in-console for routes in <24h.
   - Effort: small Console + agent change; low infra impact.
   - Suggested owner: eng-observability + seps Jonah.

B) Cost-sim sandbox: a CLI/web sandbox to replay a set of requests and show estimated token/embedding cost under different billing models (hosted/dedicated).
   - Why: removes surprise invoicing and helps customers choose Dedicated commits.
   - Metrics: reduction in billing-support tickets for sample customers.
   - Effort: moderate front-end + cost-model backfill.
   - Owner: product-hosted-api + billing.

C) Deterministic-call-mode toggle: a beta flag that enforces canonical ordering and strict schema validation for function/tool outputs with a soft-fail mode that returns validated errors.
   - Why: reduces parser breakage for customers relying on deterministic JSON.
   - Metrics: reduction in integration errors reported.
   - Effort: mostly validation layer + SDK contract.

Medium probes (quarterly, medium effort):
D) Semantic-aware fallbacks: create fallback policy templates that include alignment checks (e.g., text-similarity threshold to baseline output) before switching to cheaper variants.
   - Why: preserves quality on safety-sensitive flows.
   - Risk: adds compute for similarity checks; needs cost guardrails.
   - Owner: serving-runtime + applied-ml.

E) Webhook resiliency patterns: console-managed retry/backoff policies + a re-registration API for Private deployments to auto-heal signed webhook endpoints post-deploy.
   - Why: avoids manual re-registering and reduces failed webhook incidents.
   - Owner: private-deployments + platform-engineering.

Detailed proposal sketches (quick patch format):
1) Tail-latency quicktrace (A) — implementation sketch:
   - Add a small sampling token at routing layer that tags 1% of requests per route. Collect (route, model_variant, seq_len, latency_ms). Expose an aggregated last-10/1h histogram in Console.
   - Privacy note: do not log prompt contents; only metadata.
   - Back-of-envelope infra cost: ~0.5% storage increase for metrics pipeline.
   - Success signal: AE reports fewer high-latency escalations in next 30d.

2) Cost-sim sandbox (B) — MVP:
   - Input: CSV of sample requests or uploaded session export.
   - Simulate tokenization & embedding splits; return per-model cost estimate and suggested commit tier.
   - UX: shareable link + PDF export for procurement.
   - Quick win: integrate with existing tokenization microservice.

3) Deterministic-call-mode (C) — MVP:
   - SDK flag: deterministic_calls=true. Runtime enforces: stable key ordering (sorted keys), explicit type assertions, and returns structured error object with reason if validation fails.
   - Backward compatible: default remains off.

Customer-specific vignettes + proposed pilots:
- Fintech pilot (XBank): enable Tail-latency quicktrace + Cost-sim sandbox. Proposal: 6-week joint triage; measure percent of incidents resolved without SRE tickets.
- Health-customer (CareStack): pilot Semantic-aware fallback templates for policy doc generation flows (safety check threshold tuned by ML team).
- Marketplace (Shoply): early access to Deterministic-call-mode for their webhook-parsing pipeline.

Open questions & tradeoffs:
- Sampling rates for latency traces — what default is meaningful without creating noise? (1% feels right but test.)
- Semantic fallback cost — where to run similarity checks (edge vs centralized) for reasonable latency budget?
- Billing simulation fidelity — do we simulate compression/quantization differences that affect token counts?

Metrics & Signal for success (how we know it helped):
- 30% reduction in "unexpected latency" support tickets for pilot customers in 30d.
- 40% fewer parser-related integration bugs after Deterministic-call-mode adoption.
- Measurable reduction in billing dispute volume from customers who used Cost-sim sandbox.

Quick next steps (this week):
- Align owners: ping eng-observability, product-hosted-api, serving-runtime. (Owners suggested above).
- Scope a 2-week sprint for Tail-latency quicktrace: spec doc + API prototyping.
- Identify 3 pilot customers willing to trial the sandbox and deterministic mode. Jonah to triage outreach.

Notes to self / friction log (raw):
- AE says: "Customers want a single knob to reduce cost — but they also fear quality loss." Need clear tradeoff comms.
- Some customers can't share session exports due to compliance — build anonymized simulator path.

Appendix: short list of related tickets to reference:
- JIRA-3421: route-level histograming spike investigations (SRE)
summary: Compact working doc synthesizing customer feedback with short probes and plug-in proposals for quick pilots
